scope: Read-only configuration-contract audit; no source/test edits, builds or workloads.
conclusion: Modulo-to-mask alignment check is equivalent for all supported configurations. Keep production power-of-two assertion before clz/division in clockcache_config_init. No supported non-power-of-two configuration found.

source_evidence.finding: Default page size4096; io_config_init only stores inputs and does not validate. IO_MAX_PAGE_SIZE8192 is a header bound, not evidence backend supports8192.
io_config_valid delegates to laio_config_valid, which permits exactly4096 and rejects other sizes before geometry division. laio_handle_create also validates at931.
Public page_size0 selects default4096; resolved config passes io_config_valid before cache initialization.
Functional/test parser defaults to4096 and rejects every other supplied page size; also documents the power-of-two requirement.
Other initializer callers use parsed master geometry or explicit4096. Small functional cache fixtures copy an existing valid config and only change capacity.
Cache already uses a stored log_page_size for shifts and divides capacity by page_size. Non-power-of-two config is already unsupported; zero formerly reaches undefined clz/division.
IS_POWER_OF_2 rejects zero; platform_assert remains active in release. The mask-original assert precedes clz/division.

edge_cases: For nonzero uint64 power2 p, addr&(p-1) equals addr%p for all uint64 addresses. p-1 is defined, including p1 and largest representable power2 2^63; only4096 is currently accepted by production I/O.

Zero/reserved addresses remain aligned and are rejected by allocator membership where appropriate; the mask must not replace those checks. UINT64_MAX and the largest aligned address retain their original shape/bounds outcomes.

Runtime mutation of io_cfg geometry was already unsupported because stored log_page_size, capacities and allocations become inconsistent. No production runtime page-size mutation was found; the limitations test mutates config only for I/O-create rejection, with no live cache.

Async-load cold diagnostic modulo may remain: under the same invariant it classifies rejected addresses identically and introduces division only on the diagnostic path. Preserve UNLIKELY, alignment-before-bounds order and the bounds shift.
validation_coverage: Existing writeback invalid-address tests cover misalignment, zero/reserved, unallocated/freed, capacity, largest aligned uint64 and UINT64_MAX across synchronous/asynchronous/prefetch APIs.
Existing limitations tests cover invalid2048 and8192 configurations, both powers of two. They do not specifically cover a non-power-of-two public input.

If mask is selected, rerun writeback and limitations. A small extension of existing public rejection coverage for4095/4097/UINT64_MAX would protect error-return ordering before the internal assertion. Do not expect public page_size0 to fail; zero requests defaults.
No arithmetic test mirroring the mask is needed. A direct malformed internal config can assert; this was never a supported geometry and previously could invoke undefined behavior.
